roles.title: Coordination Sidekick
roles.headline: Keep the outcome moving.
roles.description: Coordinate a business request across people and tools with clear owners, dependencies and evidence.
roles.caption: A real document interface can hold the shared brief. This local screenshot uses fictional demonstration data.
capabilities: Clarify the requested outcome and completion evidence.
Track dependent tasks and reconcile the result.
Report completed work and the exact next action.

roles.title: Developer Sidekick
roles.headline: From a requirement to a reviewable change.
roles.description: Investigate code, make a bounded change, run the relevant checks and verify an authorised release.
roles.caption: Actual Fulcrum Code terminal renderer with a stub agent and fictional task; no source changes or model requests occurred.
capabilities: Find the cause of a reproducible bug.
Implement a small change with focused checks.
Track a release from source revision to live behaviour.

roles.title: Sales Sidekick
roles.headline: Give the relationship a next step.
roles.description: Prepare grounded follow-ups and keep contact data useful without inventing commitments or merging uncertain matches.
capabilities: Read the latest contact activity before drafting.
Propose a clear follow-up and owner.
Review duplicate candidates before a cleanup.

roles.title: Voice Sidekick
roles.headline: Make the conversation useful.
roles.description: Prepare focused Lyre agents, review what callers asked and check whether promised actions actually happened.
capabilities: Shape an agent’s opening, knowledge and fallback.
Test a controlled enquiry workflow.
Review transcripts and check the destination record.

roles.title: Workspace Sidekick
roles.headline: Bring order to everyday work.
roles.description: Triage email, prepare booking pages, extract meeting actions, review documents and manage requested file access.
roles.caption: Actual local Fulcrum Mail interface with a fictional inbox. The demonstration does not show a live automated send.
capabilities: Turn an inbox slice into a prioritised action queue.
Prepare a booking page and check availability.
Convert meeting notes into owned actions.
Review a document and the intended file access.
Explain a Wallet balance without buying credit.

roles.title: Marketing Sidekick
roles.headline: Start with a useful story.
roles.description: Turn verified product facts into a campaign brief, practical article and channel-specific copy.
roles.caption: Actual local Docs interface with template previews and a fictional account; campaign content is a task example.
capabilities: Write a brief around a real customer problem.
Prepare product-grounded article and social copy.
Track authorised publication by its actual public URL.

roles.title: Delivery Sidekick
roles.headline: Make done observable.
roles.description: Turn a delivery brief into a practical plan with dependencies, acceptance criteria and a visible handoff.
roles.caption: Actual local Docs interface. Plans and acceptance criteria can be prepared here; no project issues were created by the screenshot.
capabilities: Break an outcome into reviewable work.
Define acceptance evidence and dependencies.
Keep missing owners and dates explicit.

roles.title: Design Sidekick
roles.headline: Give the model a clear brief.
roles.description: Prepare a constrained spatial brief and, when connected, review a concept in the editable CAD model.
capabilities: Separate supplied dimensions from assumptions.
Plan editable building elements and circulation.
Review plan, 3D and section consistency.

roles.title: Private communications Sidekick
roles.headline: Say only what needs saying.
roles.description: Draft a private update from supplied context without assuming access to encrypted conversations or keys.
capabilities: Turn supplied notes into a concise message.
Keep unnecessary personal detail out of the draft.
Leave sending and privacy settings under the user’s control.

skills.name: fulcrum-coordinate-work
skills.title: Coordinate a business outcome
skills.description: Turn a cross-product business request into bounded work, track dependencies and verify outcomes across the connected Fulcrum tools. Use for tasks that span products or teams.
skills.prompt: Direct an enquiry from the inbox to a reviewed CRM follow-up without sending anything yet.
skills.outcome: A short task plan, linked results and clearly separated completed and pending stages.

skills.name: fulcrum-code-change
skills.title: Make a reviewable code change
skills.description: Investigate and implement a bounded software change in Fulcrum Code, preserving project conventions and validating the requested behaviour. Use for coding tasks in an existing project.
skills.prompt: Fix the empty-name validation bug, keep the current design and show the passing focused checks.
skills.outcome: A reviewable diff with behavioural validation and an accurate release status.

skills.name: fulcrum-release-check
skills.title: Verify a release from source to live
skills.description: Track and verify an authorised software release through source, checks, publication, deployment and live behaviour. Use when release completion or a disputed deployment status needs evidence.
skills.prompt: Check whether the authorised release actually reached production and finish any recoverable prerequisite.
skills.outcome: A release record tied to the expected revision and live behaviour.

skills.name: fulcrum-crm-follow-up
skills.title: Prepare a customer follow-up
skills.description: Prepare or carry out an authorised CRM follow-up using the contact record, recent activity and an explicit next step. Use for customer follow-up work, not bulk outreach.
skills.prompt: Read the latest enquiry and prepare a reply with the agreed next step; leave it as a draft.
skills.outcome: A source-grounded draft or verified authorised send, with its CRM next action.

skills.name: fulcrum-crm-data-cleanup
skills.title: Review CRM data quality
skills.description: Find likely CRM duplicates and inconsistent fields, propose a reversible cleanup and verify authorised changes. Use before an import or when records need reconciliation.
skills.prompt: Check this sample import for duplicates and give me a cleanup proposal before changing CRM records.
skills.outcome: A match review and field-mapping plan, with reconciled results if changes were authorised.

skills.name: fulcrum-voice-agent-setup
skills.title: Configure a focused voice agent
skills.description: Prepare and test a Lyre voice agent for a defined inbound or outbound workflow. Use for agent instructions, knowledge, tools and a controlled pilot, not unrestricted calling campaigns.
skills.prompt: Prepare an inbound enquiries agent and test its unknown-answer and callback behaviour in the browser.
skills.outcome: A bounded agent configuration, test observations and verified follow-through.

skills.name: fulcrum-call-review
skills.title: Review a call and its follow-through
skills.description: Review Lyre call evidence, separate observed outcomes from promises, and prepare the appropriate CRM or callback follow-up. Use for call quality and outcome reviews.
skills.prompt: Review this call and tell me whether the promised meeting and follow-up actually happened.
skills.outcome: An evidence-based call outcome with destination checks and a next action.

skills.name: fulcrum-inbox-triage
skills.title: Triage an inbox with context
skills.description: Organise a requested slice of Fulcrum Mail, identify urgent work and prepare grounded replies. Use for inbox review without assuming permission to delete or send.
skills.prompt: Review this morning’s enquiries, identify the ones needing action and draft replies without sending.
skills.outcome: A prioritised queue with thread references and clearly labelled drafts.

skills.name: fulcrum-booking-setup
skills.title: Set up and check a booking page
skills.description: Configure or review a Fulcrum Calendar booking page and verify availability, time zones and guest confirmation. Use for scheduling-page setup and booking troubleshooting.
skills.prompt: Prepare a 30-minute introduction page with buffers and check a known busy time before publishing.
skills.outcome: A verified availability configuration and the draft or published page link.

skills.name: fulcrum-meeting-actions
skills.title: Turn a meeting into accountable actions
skills.description: Extract decisions and action items from supplied meeting notes or an authorised transcript. Use for follow-through without inventing agreements or creating recordings.
skills.prompt: Extract decisions and owner/date action items from these notes, marking anything not agreed.
skills.outcome: A grounded decision summary and an actionable, non-invented follow-up list.

skills.name: fulcrum-document-review
skills.title: Review a business document
skills.description: Review a supplied or connected Fulcrum document for purpose, consistency, factual support and actionable revisions. Use for editorial review, not professional certification.
skills.prompt: Review this proposal for inconsistent claims and unclear next steps, then suggest focused revisions.
skills.outcome: A clear review with supported revisions and unresolved assumptions.

skills.name: fulcrum-file-sharing
skills.title: Share a file with the intended audience
skills.description: Prepare or manage Fulcrum Drive sharing with the intended file, recipient, role and expiry. Use for a requested share or access problem, not workspace-wide permission changes.
skills.prompt: Prepare a seven-day view/download link for this file and show me the access settings before sending it.
skills.outcome: The correct file link with verified audience, access and expiry.

skills.name: fulcrum-wallet-check
skills.title: Reconcile a Wallet balance question
skills.description: Explain Fulcrum Wallet balance, holds, credit lots and history for the selected account. Use for read-only billing investigation, not purchases or plan changes.
skills.prompt: Explain why this Wallet balance changed and distinguish the held amount from settled usage.
skills.outcome: A read-only reconciliation with transaction evidence and unresolved differences.

skills.name: fulcrum-campaign-brief
skills.title: Prepare a grounded campaign brief
skills.description: Create a practical marketing or outreach brief with audience, claims, channels, assets and measurement. Use for campaign planning and article preparation; publication requires its own authorised scope.
skills.prompt: Prepare an article showing how a Sidekick turns a customer enquiry into a reviewed next action.
skills.outcome: A fact-checked campaign brief, channel drafts and publication evidence if authorised.

skills.name: fulcrum-project-planning
skills.title: Plan work with acceptance evidence
skills.description: Turn a requested delivery outcome into issues, dependencies and acceptance criteria in the available project workspace. Use for a bounded project or sprint plan.
skills.prompt: Turn this launch brief into a small delivery plan with dependencies and checkable acceptance criteria.
skills.outcome: A practical issue plan with explicit evidence and undecided owners or dates.

skills.name: fulcrum-cad-design-brief
skills.title: Prepare an editable CAD design brief
skills.description: Translate a spatial design request into a constrained Fulcrum CAD brief and reviewable modelling steps. Use for concept design, not engineering sign-off or construction certification.
skills.prompt: Prepare a compact one-bedroom cabin concept brief with dimensions and unresolved site assumptions.
skills.outcome: A constrained modelling brief or verified editable concept, with assumptions kept visible.

skills.name: fulcrum-private-message-draft
skills.title: Draft a private message
skills.description: Prepare a concise private message from user-supplied context, including for Kyphra. Use for drafting without accessing private conversations or handling encryption keys.
skills.prompt: Draft a discreet two-sentence update from these notes; do not send or access any chats.
skills.outcome: A concise private draft with no assumed messaging integration.
